description: This file contains CSS styles defining the visual theme and layout for a calculator application, including button styles, layout configurations, and theme variables.

classes.name: .App
classes.description: Main application container class that sets layout and background.

classes.name: .calc-container
classes.description: Container for the calculator UI elements with styling for size and layout.

classes.name: .calc-display
classes.description: Display area of the calculator showing current input and results.

classes.name: .calc-btn-ios
classes.description: Button styles inspired by iOS design guidelines for calculator buttons.

classes.name: .calc-btn-ios-num
classes.description: Button styles for numerical input buttons.

classes.name: .calc-btn-ios-utility
classes.description: Button styles for utility functions such as clear and backspace.

classes.name: .calc-btn-ios-op
classes.description: Button styles for operation buttons such as add, subtract, multiply, and divide.

classes.name: .calc-btn-ios-equals
classes.description: Button styles for the equals function in the calculator.
